item.title: Gunsmoke - My Father's Guitar
item.description: A wanderer believes his father's guitar is worth killing for.

item.title: The Big Valley - The Time After Midnight
item.description: Jarrod is blinded by an explosion set by a scoundrel who doesn’t want to face him as acting district attorney at trial. The family encourages Jarrod to continue with the case, and assists him at the trial.

item.title: Wagon Train - The Bill Tawnee Story
item.description: Bill Tawnee served his country heroically. When Major Adams recognizes him on the trail, he asks his wife to join his wagon train even though there is plenty of anti-indian sentiment afloat.

item.title: The Wild Wild West - The Night of the Eccentrics
item.description: Searching for a fellow agent, Jim and Artie go to a circus where they find themselves battling the Eccentrics, a group of assassins controlled by the vicious Count Manzeppi.

item.title: Bugs Bunny and Friends - False Hare, Of Rice And Hen, The Brave Little Bat, The Million Hare, The Cat's Bah, Chaser On The Rocks, The Windblown Hare
item.description: "The big bad Wolf and his cousin setup a rabbit club as a front for a rabbit trap. Bugs plays along with their club just to cause more trouble for the Wolves. , Miss Prissy falls in love with Foggy when he’s the only one to treat her kindly. , Sniffle's car breaks down in a storm. item.title: The Woody Woodpecker Show - Wicket Wacky, The Wacky Weed, Man's Best Friend, Bathing Buddies, Hay Rube, Chilly Willy, Wacky-bye Baby
item.description: "Woody plays a game of croquet and disturbs the underground parlor of a gopher., Andy buys a flower for his front yard, but it is attacked by a persistant weed., An overtired hunting dog named Snoozer can't get a good night's rest., When Woody drops a quarter down the drain of his bathtub, he's desperate to get it back, even annoying his landlord, Wally Walrus., Sugarfoot falls in love with a circus horse named Starbrite and ends up fighting with a trainer he sees beating her., Chilly boards a s

item.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Quiet Please!, The Fishing Bear, Carmen Get It
item.description: "Spike warns Tom not to make any noise, so Jerry tries to., Barney Bear goes fishing and has problems catching any fish because a duck keeps getting in the way., The antics of Tom and Jerry head to the opera house in a musical episode."

item.title: Popeye and Pals - Rodeo Romeo, I Yam Love Sick, King of the Mardi Gras
item.description: "When Olive becomes enamored with cowboy Bluto at the rodeo, Popeye uses spinach to beat him in all the events., Popeye plays sick to win Olive's attention., Popeye and Bluto strive for the title "King of the Mardi Gras," with the best man winning the title and Olive Oyl."

item.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - Granny Learns to Drive
item.description: After Granny takes a cab home and gets charged for the ride, she decides that it is time for her to learn how to drive. The taxi driver who took Granny home is having trouble collecting the fair, and after a series of events begins to believe that he is in a mental hospital. Granny, during her driving lesson, mistakenly gets on the road.

item.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - Jed, Incorporated
item.description: Jed becomes head of a corporation, which Drysdale organized for him as a tax write-off. The Clampetts decide they want to help out at their corporation, and get the penthouse suite in the bank building. They get all dressed up, Elly in one of her ball gowns, and go to the bank.
